generations.prompt: Photoreal, present day, inside a modern cinema with black leather recliners, 35 mm, the camera locked off at the front of the house looking up at the third row; it does not move. The woman with loose shoulder-length hair in the oversized blazer looks down at the glowing phone in her lap and half-smiles as the bearded man in the green hoodie leans over to look at it with her and says something; she laughs quietly. Then the cold white flicker from the screen above the lens brightens and changes; she turns the phone face-down in her lap and looks up at the screen, the man sits back, and both go quiet and still, her face falling serious; the older woman with the silver bob beside her and the people behind go still too, no one moving, no one speaking. Sound: a murmuring house, a quiet laugh, then a hush; no music. Exactly the people already in the frame; nobody new enters. No on-screen text, no signs, no lettering anywhere; the phone screen is a plain blur.
